label: Updated 12 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Niemann Wins LIV Playoff
items.text: Joaquin Niemann made birdie on the first playoff hole to beat Talor Gooch at LIV Golf Korea, earning his eighth career LIV title as Bryson DeChambeau missed the playoff by one shot.

items.headline: PGA Tour CEO Addresses Overhaul
items.text: The PGA Tour CEO released a statement emphasizing the tour's plan to get the biggest stars competing against each other more often as part of a proposed overhaul.
